title: ആയുർവേദത്തിലെ സ്ത്രീ വിരുദ്ധത The Science Brigade
description:
In the second episode of the Charaka Samhita parayanam, The Science Brigade looks at the misogynistic approaches made in the ancient texts of Ayurveda.
#misogyny #ayurveda #thesciencebrigade

This is a live recording of the discussion on Charaka Samhitha conducted by The Science Brigade on Fri, 3rd September 2021 in Clubhouse. This recording is made public after receiving permission from TSB. This recording is in Malayalam
